thread:
maria: FYI found a couple of broken links and one outdated SDK snippet in the playground observability example. Putting notes here before I open a PR. :wave:

maria: Broken links: /console/playground/kvcache -> 404, /docs/examples/old-tracehook -> 404. The kvcache example also references `client.prefetch()` which is deprecated in the new SDK.

devon: thanks — can you paste the exact snippet that needs replacement? also do we need a redirect for the page if it moved? :eyes:

maria: here's the current snippet (from the playground page):

```
# python
from redwood import ConsoleClient
client = ConsoleClient()
client.prefetch('session_123', max_prefix=512)
```

maria: should be updated to `client.kv_prefetch('session_123', max_items=5)` and note the API change in the SDK section.

linkchecker-bot: Link check result for /console/playground/observability: 2 broken links found -> [/console/playground/kvcache, /docs/examples/old-tracehook]. Severity: medium.

ashok: The new `kv_prefetch` has a slightly different return shape (keys vs items). If you change the snippet, also update the code example that shows cost/latency calculation — it expects the old dict shape. Quick replacement suggestion:

```
# python
items = client.kv_prefetch('session_123', max_items=5)
# items -> list of {"key": "...", "value": "...", "latency_ms": 2}
```

ashok: and we should add a note in the migration tips: "If you relied on `prefetch` for prefix-based caching, switch to `kv_prefetch` and update traces to use `key` metadata."

sara: I can open the PR this afternoon. Who should I tag to review? I can also add frontmatter redirects if we move pages.

jen: tag SDK owners and console docs. cc @alex — would you take a quick look at the redirect?

devon: for redirects put this at top of the moved md:

```
---
redirect_from:
  - /console/playground/kvcache
---
```
devon: that'll keep existing links working while we fix upstream references. Also add a short changelog line in the playground page about trace/kv changes so customers see it.

maria: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823 — title: "playground: refactor kv example, fix broken links, update sdk snippet". Checklist in PR description: update snippet, update cost/latency note, add redirect, run link-check CI.

alex: scanning the PR now. small nit: prefer `max_items` name kept but default to 5, add a brief example of reshaping old return to new for backward compatibility. otherwise :+1: from me.

jen: can we also add a tiny trace screenshot (png) showing the new `key` field in traces? helps QA.

maria: yep will add screenshot and a short regression test note in PR. Marking this as docs-pr-ready once CI passes. :thumbsup:

sara: I'll assign reviewers and schedule a quick pair review after lunch. Thanks all!
